gbm_population_evidence.quote: Subjects must have histologically or cytologically confirmed WHO Grade IV Glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: evaluate the addition of carvedilol with standard of care treatment to determine if it will improve progression-free survival

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in the front line setting in patients with glioblastoma multiforme (GBM)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Quantify CTCs via qRT-PCR assay and to assess how the trend of CTCs correspond to disease status as measured by RANO criteria on neuro-imaging.

role_evidence.quote: continue daily until the end of adjuvant cycle 6 of temozolomide and Tumor Treated Fields

source_quote.quote: Quantify CTCs via qRT-PCR assay and to assess how the trend of CTCs correspond to disease status as measured by RANO criteria on neuro-imaging.

coder_notes: Registered phase is EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Temozolomide, radiotherapy and TTFields are standard backbone given to all; temozolomide not registered as an intervention but stated in the arm text. Carvedilol is a licensed antihypertensive tested for antitumour effect. target_engagement coded unclear: a CTC biomarker endpoint is planned but the record does not link it to carvedilol's target; it is tracked against disease response.
